key_facts: Colombia's Aerospace Force finalized a deal to buy two KC-390 Millennium airlifters from Embraer for roughly $366 million.
The first aircraft is expected to arrive in 2029, followed by the second in 2030.
This is at least the third contract win for the KC-390 Millennium this year, following orders by the UAE in May and Greece in June.
Embraer is studying plans, through a partnership with Northrop Grumman, to outfit the KC-390 with a dedicated refueling boom.
Colombia's legacy C-130 fleet includes an aircraft that crashed in March, killing 69 people.
